title: Email classification & extraction output
description: The structured output your classification/extraction LLM step must return for every email. You may ADD fields if useful, but these fields are required and must follow these types.

secondary_intent.description: A second need in the same email, if any. Otherwise null.

order_id.description: Order ID exactly as KC-#### if mentioned in the email. Otherwise null. Do not guess.

language.description: en = English, hi = Hindi (Devanagari), hinglish = Hindi written in Latin script mixed with English.

confidence.description: How confident the model is in the intent classification (0 to 1).

summary.description: One-line summary for the support team, in English.

examples.summary: Customer asking for delivery date of order KC-1000.
